LanguageData.CQFExample_Beacon_Opening: Echo Beacon: The old comms tower has lit itself up, repeating an ancient identification code into deep space. The signal is out — now you wait to see what answers.
LanguageData.CQFExample_Beacon_Echo: Echo Beacon: A structured reply code has come back from deep space. Something heard the beacon, and it is following the signal here.
LanguageData.CQFExample_Signal_BeaconBonus: Beacon Response: The reply code matches your beacon's identification exactly — this shipment was meant for that tower.
LanguageData.CQFExample_Commission_Opening: The Guide's Cache: The wandering guide has agreed to hand over an old supply cache. He needs to confirm it is still there first — wait for his word.
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_Greeting: The dusty traveler looks {Interviewer_labelShort} up and down: "Huh. Still living settlements out here on the rim. I'm a guide — news, herbs, and a few places nobody else knows. All negotiable."
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_Rumor1: "The northern trade road's gone bad lately — mechanoids prowling the old highway. Route your caravans south."
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_Rumor2: "Heard a caravan dug a whole pod of old-world medicine out of the snowfields. Luck's a strange thing."
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_Rumor3: "The tribes put up a checkpoint at the mountain pass. Don't ask how I know — my boots see more than your radar."
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_Farewell: The guide brushes the dust off his coat: "That's all for now. Long road ahead — take care of yourselves."
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_ReasonTaken: You have already taken the guide's commission.
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_MsgHerbs: The guide tosses over a bundle of herbs ({0}): "Keep them dry."
LanguageData.CQFExample_Guide_MsgBefriend: The guide grins and promises to put in a good word for your colony among his people.
